name: parity-incoming-miss-no-foreign-products
source: PLAN-chatbot-answer-half-reattach.md slice R1 / AC-1688 (F9, hand pass 8/9): an incoming miss for a code the resolver could not place leaked stock rows for the WHOLE catalogue instead of staying scoped to the asked code (turn_runtime._answered_unfiltered returning False for an empty entity list; turn/fetch.py::_climb re-running the primary [now empty] spec against the inventory ladder rung - security review N-1). Nothing on stock or outstanding purchase orders either.' with no dump at all. 'Incoming srtwt7202-new' (one of hand pass 8's own three F8 texts) IS measured live, twice, identically, to reproduce the SAME style of leak the UAC names ('incoming miss' -> an unfiltered stock dump), so it is pinned here instead, under AC-1688, rather than left in parity-single-option-never-rostered.json where it does not reproduce that chain's own defect.
